products.name: Gulnar Embroidered Dobby Suit
products.shortDescription: Tilla-embroidered dobby two-piece with zari detailing on the neckline, sleeves and hem borders.
products.description:
Gulnar Embroidered Dobby Suit is part of our Embroidered Dobby line — cut, finished and quality-checked in our Islamabad atelier. Tilla-embroidered dobby two-piece with zari detailing on the neckline, sleeves and hem borders.

The dobby fabric is sourced from certified Pakistani mills and pre-washed for softness and colour fastness. Every piece is inspected twice before it ships, and embroidery (where present) is secured with a backing layer so it stays pristine through wear and washing.

Styling note: pair it with khussa or a modern flat, and layer with our shawls in colder months. The silhouette is true to size — if you prefer a relaxed fit, we recommend going one size up.
details: Fabric: Dobby
Line: Embroidered Dobby
Includes: Kurta and trouser (dupatta where pictured)
Fit: True to size, tailored silhouette
Care: Gentle machine wash inside-out; dry clean embellished pieces
Made in Pakistan — Al Nain atelier, Islamabad

reviews.title: Absolutely stunning
reviews.text: The embroidery is even better in person. Wore it on Eid and got endless compliments. True to size.

reviews.title: Beautiful but delicate
reviews.text: Gorgeous suit — just handle the embroidered borders with care, the work is fine and detailed.

reviews.title: The pearl buttons!
reviews.text: The tassel buttons are such a beautiful detail. Dobby fabric feels premium, fits perfectly.

reviews.title: Bought both colours
reviews.text: My sister and I got the sage and beige — the co-ord fits beautifully and the embroidery is neat.

reviews.title: Heirloom quality
reviews.text: Real chikankari, not machine imitation. My mother approved — highest possible praise.

reviews.title: Bridal-worthy
reviews.text: Wore it at my nikkah. Featherlight and the dabka work is couture level.

reviews.title: Elegant
reviews.text: Beautiful piece. Delivery took a day longer than promised, hence 4 stars.

reviews.title: Mirror work catches every light
reviews.text: Slightly snug on the arms, size up if in doubt — but absolutely worth it.

reviews.title: Great daily wear
reviews.text: Soft khaddar, generous fit. The rust print is beautiful in daylight.

reviews.title: Third one I bought
reviews.text: This is my third Zarlish suit. Says everything.

reviews.title: Lovely print
reviews.text: The signature print looks exactly like the photos. Fabric is soft after first wash.

reviews.title: Everyday favourite
reviews.text: Light, easy, and the pastel print goes with everything.

reviews.title: Print quality is superb
reviews.text: Dark florals look richer in person. No fading after wash.

reviews.title: Perfect for winter
reviews.text: Warmer than expected and the maroon is regal. Dupatta print is gorgeous.

reviews.title: Good buy on sale
reviews.text: Great value at the sale price. True to size.

reviews.title: Nice kurta
reviews.text: Earthy colours as pictured. Would love matching trousers as an option.

reviews.title: Co-ord goals
reviews.text: The blush set is so pretty — got compliments at uni all day.

reviews.title: Shade slightly different
reviews.text: Pretty suit but the gold is a shade deeper than the website photo.

reviews.title: Spam review text
reviews.text: Visit my page for cheap replicas!!!

testimonials.name: Mahnoor Ali
testimonials.text: Al Nain has become my go-to for every Eid and shaadi. The embroidery quality rivals designer houses at twice the price.

testimonials.name: Ayesha Raza
testimonials.text: The khaddar prints are unmatched. Colours stay fresh wash after wash, and delivery is always on time.

testimonials.name: Kiran Fatima
testimonials.text: Ordered two dobby co-ords with cash on delivery — the fit was perfect and the pearl-button detailing is beautiful.

testimonials.name: Hassan Javed
testimonials.text: Ordered for my wife and sister — premium fabric, honest sizing, and COD nationwide. Exactly how online shopping should work in Pakistan.

messages.name: Mahira Aslam
messages.message: Do you offer custom stitching for the Roshanay dobby formal? I need a slightly longer kameez length for a December barat.

messages.name: Usman Tariq
messages.message: My order arrived a day early — the quality is fantastic. Do you offer gift packaging for Eid orders?
